clue.text: Quite vain, to be blunt

definitions.meaning: an effort that is quite in vain achieves nothing and has no purpose
a blunt blade or pencil literally lacks a sharp tip

explanation.surface: Someone frankly admitting that an exercise was entirely futile.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is read literally: something without a point is blunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Futile and without a sharp tip are both literal and figurative senses of lacking a point.

clue.text: Be under professional scrutiny

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece placed under another comes after it

parts.note: pro is the short form of professional
taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to submit oneself to expert examination.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'under' puts BE below PRO.
explanation.definitionFit: A probe is a close investigation, synonymous with careful examination or scrutiny.

clue.text: One extremely behind schedule in divorce

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
so means very or extremely, as in 'so tired'
late means arriving after the scheduled time

explanation.surface: A single overdue person in the middle of a marriage break-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'divorce' is a verb here, meaning to cut off or separate.
explanation.definitionFit: To divorce one thing from another is to separate or set it apart, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Head of state moves to centre, showing discrimination

indicators.note: the opening letter is said to shift into the middle of the word state

parts.note: taken as written, its head being the letter S

explanation.surface: A head of state relocates to the centre ground, displaying good judgement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head of state' points to the first letter S, which 'moves to centre' of STATE, giving T-A-S-T-E.
explanation.definitionFit: Taste is discernment in aesthetic matters, the sense of discrimination meaning fine judgement.

clue.text: Trap seen, ran off!

indicators.note: off suggests the letters going astray or running away into a new order

explanation.surface: A trap has been spotted, so someone flees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges the letters of SEEN and RAN.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensnare is to catch in a snare, a synonym of the verb to trap.

clue.text: Young lad subtracting initially, then multiplying

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word subtracting

parts.note: tripling is multiplying by three

explanation.surface: A schoolboy doing arithmetic, first taking away and then multiplying.
explanation.walkthrough: The arithmetic surface hides a charade of S and TRIPLING.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripling is a youth or adolescent boy, a slightly old-fashioned synonym.

clue.text: Work in church and you may wear it

definitions.meaning: to manage or get by, as in coping with a task

definitions.text: in church and you may wear it
definitions.meaning: a long ceremonial cloak worn by clergy in church

explanation.surface: A remark about a job at church that comes with its own garment.
explanation.definitionFit: To cope is to manage or deal with things; a cope is also a liturgical vestment worn by priests.

clue.text: Behave well — or have romp around in bed!

indicators.note: in signals that one piece is placed inside the word for bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of romp being turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: A choice between good conduct and frolicking in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' gives the scrambled letters MPOR, which go 'in' the bed; the surface's romp in bed hides a word for good conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: To comport oneself is to conduct oneself or behave, usually properly.

clue.text: Teardrops shed for hungry animals

indicators.note: shed suggests the letters being cast off and scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Crocodile tears shed by animals looking for a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed' looks like a verb of weeping but signals an anagram of TEARDROPS.
explanation.definitionFit: Predators are hunting creatures that prey on others, so hungry beasts in search of food.

clue.text: Giant firm states no profit is taken

indicators.note: the outer word takes in, or absorbs, another piece within it

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
US is the United States
a loss is the opposite of a profit

explanation.surface: A huge company reports that it made no profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is taken' means the loss is absorbed between the firm and the states, read as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: A colossus is a person or thing of enormous size, named after the giant statue at Rhodes.

clue.text: WWII field marshal gains military medal in new role

indicators.note: gains means the rearranged word takes another piece into itself
new indicates a fresh arrangement of the letters of role

parts.note: MM is the abbreviation for the Military Medal

explanation.surface: A wartime field marshal receives a decoration in his new posting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges the letters to ROEL, and 'gains' takes the medal abbreviation into the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Erwin Rommel was a German field marshal of the Second World War, nicknamed the Desert Fox.

clue.text: A tense assembly of university governors

indicators.note: assembly suggests the letters being put together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An anxious meeting of the people who run a university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly of' rearranges A and TENSE.
explanation.definitionFit: At many universities the senate is the governing body of academics.

clue.text: Thumbs up for it!

parts.note: a raised thumb is the gesture people make to show they back something

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic thumbs-up gesture for something.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving a thumbs up signals agreement or endorsement of a proposal.

clue.text: Beat nervous tension

definitions.meaning: the accent or emphasis falling on a syllable in a rhythm

explanation.surface: A complaint about being beaten by nerves.
explanation.definitionFit: Stress is both rhythmic emphasis in verse or music and psychological strain.

clue.text: Go on board deck

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: a turn is a go, as in 'your go'
a table is a board, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: An instruction to go and stand on a ship's deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deck' is the record deck of a hi-fi, not a ship's deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A record deck is the rotating platform that plays vinyl records.

clue.text: What the bank has to say of your account?

definitions.text: What the bank has to say of your account?

parts.words: What the bank has to say of your account?
parts.note: the clue reads like a bank's verbal comment but means the printed summary of transactions it sends

explanation.surface: A question about the bank's opinion of a customer.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank statement is the periodic record of deposits and withdrawals on an account.

clue.text: A compulsory turnout

parts.note: turnout reads as attendance at an event but means being turned out of one's home

explanation.surface: An event that everyone must attend.
explanation.definitionFit: An eviction is the forced removal of a tenant from a property.

clue.text: Equestrian discipline is a habit that comes with time

parts.note: a habit is a costume or form of dress, as in riding habit
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A riding sport described as a routine that takes time to learn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'habit' suggests routine but is clothing, like a riding habit.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage is the competitive equestrian sport of precise trained horse movements.

clue.text: Survey the whole lot with a girl

parts.note: a sum is a total, the whole amount
Mary is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Surveying everything together with a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A summary is a brief survey or overview of the main points.

clue.text: Let care be arranged for tragic female

indicators.note: the letters are to be arranged in a different order

explanation.surface: A request for care to be organised for a woman in distress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be arranged' rearranges LET and CARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra is the heroine of Greek tragedies by Sophocles and Euripides.

clue.text: Decorate without a central point and it becomes gaudy

indicators.note: the middle letter, also a compass point, is removed

parts.note: to garnish is to decorate food

explanation.surface: Advice that ornamentation lacking a focal point looks tacky.
explanation.walkthrough: N (north, a compass point) is the central letter of GARNISH; removing it gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Garish means showy and lurid, a close synonym of gaudy.

clue.text: A cross in Italy shows where a composer is buried

indicators.note: the letters lie buried inside the run of words cross in Italy

explanation.surface: A cross in Italy marks the grave of a composer.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is a grave marker; the composer is concealed in cROSS IN Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Gioachino Rossini was an Italian composer of operas such as The Barber of Seville.

clue.text: Run caused by panic in the stock market?

definitions.text: Run caused by panic in the stock market?

parts.words: Run caused by panic in the stock market?
parts.note: stock means livestock, so a panicked rush of cattle rather than a financial run

explanation.surface: A run on shares caused by panicked traders.
explanation.definitionFit: A stampede is a sudden panicked rush of a herd of animals.

clue.text: Judge gives fools direction

parts.note: asses are fools
S is south, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A judge instructs idiots on what to do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'direction' looks like instructions but is the compass point S.
explanation.definitionFit: To judge something is to assess or evaluate it.

clue.text: Left in a unit entirely without support

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for left inside a and unit

parts.note: one is a single unit

explanation.surface: Someone left in a squad with nobody backing them.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes inside A ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: To be alone is to be on one's own, with no one to help.

clue.text: Said to have remained sober

indicators.note: said indicates the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: stayed means remained

explanation.surface: Someone reported to have stayed on the wagon.
explanation.walkthrough: STAID sounds like STAYED.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid means sedate and serious, close to sober in manner.

clue.text: Burning a mark on a horse

parts.note: a blaze is a white stripe down a horse's face

explanation.surface: Branding a horse with a hot iron.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests branding, but a blaze is the white facial stripe on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Ablaze means on fire, a synonym for burning.

clue.text: Current keeping river very warm

indicators.note: keeping means one word holds the other within it

parts.note: topical means of current interest

explanation.surface: An ocean current that keeps a river hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' suggests water flow but means up to date.
explanation.definitionFit: Tropical weather is hot and humid, like that of the tropics.

clue.text: Tax it out of frivolity

indicators.note: out of means the letters are taken away from the word for frivolity

parts.note: levity is light-hearted frivolity
taken as written

explanation.surface: A suggestion to cut a tax from silliness.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove IT from LEVITY.
explanation.definitionFit: A levy is a tax or charge imposed by an authority.

clue.text: Blow makes market reel

parts.note: trade is commerce, the market
to wind is to reel in a line

explanation.surface: A blow that makes the market stagger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blow' looks like a punch but is a gust; 'reel' looks like staggering.
explanation.definitionFit: A trade wind is a steady tropical wind, and to blow is what wind does.
